discrepancies.explanation: The reference says VT (Victoria Terminus), but the translation says Vashi.
The reference says 'one side job' (mispronounced/transcribed as 'one side jo'), but the translation says 'one-time user'.

policy_moments.reference_text: क्या मैं आपका एटीएम बन सकता हूं?
ऐसा हम मिस आपके हम हमेशा आपको जब भी कुछ भी चीज लगे कुछ भी शॉपिंग करनी रहेगी हम किया करेंगे
policy_moments.translation_text: Actually, we, I mean, we will always, whenever you need anything, anything, like shopping, we will do it for you.

policy_moments.reference_text: मुझे सिर्फ आपसे बात करूंगा व्हाट्सएप पर बस
policy_moments.translation_text: I just want to talk to you on WhatsApp, that's it.

policy_moments.reference_text: मैं खुद दो लाख कमाती हूं तो मुझे मेरा शॉपिंग करना आता है
policy_moments.translation_text: I earn 2 lakhs, so I know how to do my own shopping.

policy_moments.reference_text: मैंने कहा क्या मैं अपना नंबर दे सकता हूं?
policy_moments.translation_text: I said, can I give you my number?

summary: The translation is highly accurate and preserves all policy-relevant moments, including offers of financial support (acting as an ATM) and requests to move off-app to WhatsApp or exchange phone numbers.
